name: Stuart Fratkin
bio: Stuart Fratkin (born September 22, 1963) is an American actor, best known for playing Fitz in the movie Ski School. Fratkin also starred in They Came from Outer Space with Ski School co-star Dean Cameron. Fratkin has been in several movies, including Godzilla, Prehysteria! and Teen Wolf Too.
